SaveData.GetInst itself has raw MethodDef row c8493100000096003b7f0800e8da0200ed3b, RVA 0x003149C8, exact signature blob 000012a938, and an exact 6-byte body with SHA-256 2e12171cc208596025d626b80263f5597a296cc70ab5856f40c8660292702f40; it loads static SaveData.inst (0x040064EC) and returns it.
